query:
UPDATE refresh_tokens
        SET revoked_at = NOW(), revoked_reason = 'reuse'
        WHERE revoked_at IS NULL
          AND session_id = (
              SELECT session_id FROM refresh_tokens
              WHERE token_hash = $1
                AND revoked_reason = 'rotated'
                AND revoked_at < NOW() - make_interval(secs => $2)
          )
